title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Urban Green Graduation programme will work in Dhaka Bangladesh. It aims to contribute to Concern Bangladesh’s Green Graduation thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is to ensure households can sustainably meet their basic needs and have improved coping strategies through strengthened livelihoods which place value on the natural environment. The programme will support over 69,870 urban extreme poor people living on pavements or informal settlements including female-headed households and households with disabled members. This will be done through supporting households with start-up capital or asset tranfers, supporting households to meet their basic needs, households engaged with micro-enterprises and improved access to affordable, accessible and appropriate financial services and increased savings.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: To contribute to improving access to and availability of health, nutrition and DRR services for camp populations and host communities. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Gender equality 2: this is the main objective of the outcome, which is aimed at improving women’s participation and representation in targeted communities. DRR 1: Training includes disaster and climate risk management.Aid to Environment 1: Concern’s Green Graduation programme added a 5th pillar to the traditional graduation model - the ‘green’ aspect which aims to improve environmental protection and stability through awareness raising, capacity building, assessing environmental impacts, reducing and managing environmental risks and increasing natural assets.Capacity Building 1: Participants' capacity is built through training such as on financial management, vocational skills, disaster and climate risk management, gender transformation, business skills, and environmental sustainability.Nutrition 1: Through group and HH messaging on nutrition, the nutritional status of HHs is improved.
